reason: Current Bayern Munich player, signed from PSV on 1 July 2026. Morocco international. Sources agree on the club move, shirt number and the 6-1 cup win in which he scored.

birthPlace.note: Only Footmercato gives a birthplace among the sources opened. FotMob does not list one.

nationality.note: FotMob lists Morocco as country, Bundesliga calls him a Morocco international. Footmercato also lists Belgium as a second nationality. That is not confirmed by a federation source, so it is left out of the page.
